name: Require PR Description
description: Blocks gh pr create commands when no --body flag is provided to ensure PRs have descriptions
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Require --body flag on gh pr create
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'gh\s+pr\s+create'; then
  if ! echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE '--body'; then
    echo "BLOCKED: PR must include a description. Add --body flag to gh pr create."
    exit 2
  fi
fi
exit 0
